_comment: Post-STT corrections: the stand-in for config/stt_fixes.json (local, .gitignore: it lists the team's clients and products). Key = what it should be, value = how STT writes it. Whole words, case-insensitive; multi-word variants allowed. Applied before closers, kill phrases and the brain. STT has no vocabulary hints here: OpenRouter drops the prompt, SpeechKit streaming has none; «Корабль» = SpeechKit on «Кора».
